entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: A leonin planeswalker from Naya, Alara, a healer and warrior who joined the Gatewatch, was compleated into a sleeper agent and later un-compleated.

entities.name: Phyrexian Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: The compleated version of Ajani with a cybernetic eye and Phyrexian armor, loyal to Elesh Norn and eager to bring his friends into the fold.

entities.name: Jazal
entities.description: Ajani's older brother, kha of the Qasal Valley pride, killed in his lair with his black axe.

entities.name: Zaliki
entities.description: The tribe shaman and Ajani's friend who actually killed Jazal, manipulated by Marisi, and later became Kha.

entities.name: Tenoch
entities.description: A rival leonin who persecuted Ajani and stole his kill.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: A legendary hero who manipulated Zaliki into killing Jazal and was slain by him.

entities.name: Sarkhan Vol
entities.description: A planeswalker who counseled the new walker Ajani on Jund and later became a corrupted dragon on Tarkir.

entities.name: Elspeth Tirel
entities.description: A planeswalker and Ajani's close friend, who was murdered by Heliod on Theros and later became his ally against Phyrexia.

entities.name: Nicol Bolas
entities.description: An elder dragon planeswalker whom Ajani banished from Alara and later fought at Ravnica.

entities.name: Heliod
entities.description: A Theros god who killed Elspeth and was compleated and killed by Kaya.

entities.name: Xenagos
entities.description: A god whom Elspeth struck down in Nyx.

entities.name: Brimaz
entities.description: A leonin king on Theros who was Ajani's friend.

entities.name: Kaya Cassir
entities.description: A planeswalker who killed the compleated Heliod on Theros.

entities.name: Tamiyo
entities.description: Ajani's old companion who was later compleated.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: An artificer planeswalker whose plans Ajani opposed on Kaladesh and who later cleaned himself with Elspeth's cloak.

entities.name: Pia Nalaar
entities.description: A Renegade Prime of Ghirapur whom Tezzeret planned to kill.

entities.name: Oviya Pashiri
entities.description: A Renegade whom Ajani rescued from the Dhund.

entities.name: Chandra Nalaar
entities.description: A planeswalker and Gatewatch member and ally of Ajani.

entities.name: Nissa Revane
entities.description: A planeswalker rescued with Oviya and Chandra.

entities.name: Gatewatch
entities.description: An alliance of planeswalkers that Ajani joined after the Aether Revolt.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: The Weatherlight's captain whom Ajani recruited and who sent him to rescue Karn.

entities.name: Gideon Jura
entities.description: A Gatewatch planeswalker whose memorial Ajani attended.

entities.name: Liliana Vess
entities.description: A planeswalker who met Ajani on Arcavios and was later seen fighting Jace.

entities.name: Karn
entities.description: A being Ajani rescued, later helped capture and presided over the dismantling of, and who helped un-compleat him.

entities.name: Teferi Akosa
entities.description: A character Ajani fought to stop from learning the Sylex's use and who later helped un-compleat him.

entities.name: Jaya Ballard
entities.description: A Dominarian killed by the compleated Ajani at the Mana Rig.

entities.name: Elesh Norn
entities.description: The praetor whose favored lieutenant Ajani became.

entities.name: Sheoldred
entities.description: A praetor decapitated by Ajani on Norn's command.

entities.name: Melira
entities.description: A Mirran who helped restore Ajani's body.

entities.name: Nahiri
entities.description: A compleated planeswalker who rebuffed Ajani and destroyed her spark.

entities.name: Narset
entities.description: A planeswalker who with Elspeth was aided by Ajani against Sarkhan's dragons.

entities.name: Ugin
entities.description: The spirit dragon who defeated Sarkhan and calmed the wild dragons.

entities.name: Kirol
entities.description: A Strixhaven student for whom Ajani served as advisor.

entities.name: Tamira
entities.description: A Strixhaven student saved by Ajani's healing magic.

entities.name: Lluwen
entities.description: An elven hunter who deserted Morcant and joined Strixhaven.

entities.name: Morcant
entities.description: An elven perfect who pressed students into service and hunted Isilu.

entities.name: Jace Beleren
entities.description: A planeswalker who splintered his personality and died in the Echoverse.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker who stabbed Jace in the back to end the Theorist's ritual.

entities.name: Garruk
entities.description: A planeswalker collected to help overcome Jace's illusions.

entities.name: Emrakul
entities.description: An Eldrazi titan that appeared to consume the collapsing Echoverse.

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: The Alara shard where Ajani was born.

entities.name: Jund
entities.description: An Alara shard where Ajani met Sarkhan Vol and which was lost in the Conflux.

entities.name: Bant
entities.description: An Alara shard where Elspeth cared for Ajani.

entities.name: Theros
entities.description: A plane where Elspeth died and Ajani found a place among the leonin.

entities.name: Kaladesh
entities.description: The plane where Ajani helped the Renegades against Tezzeret.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: The plane where Ajani was compleated.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The plane of the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Tarkir
entities.description: A plane where Ajani sought refuge.

entities.name: Arcavios
entities.description: The plane of Strixhaven where Ajani became an advisor.

entities.name: Lorwyn-Shadowmoor
entities.description: The plane where Ajani rescued Strixhaven students.

entities.name: Echoverse
entities.description: The alternate multiverse where Jace died.

entities.name: New Phyrexia
entities.description: The Phyrexian plane where Ajani served Norn.

entities.name: Zhalfir
entities.description: The plane to which the frozen Ajani was brought.

entities.name: Urborg
entities.description: The place where Ajani found Elspeth in gladiator pits.

entities.name: Conflux
entities.description: The convergence of Alara's shards, during which Ajani banished Bolas.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The final confrontation with Bolas on Ravnica.

entities.name: Aether Revolt
entities.description: The Renegade uprising on Kaladesh.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: The invasion that ended with Ajani's un-compleation.

events.summary: Ajani is born an albino Nacatl, an outcast among his pride.
events.quote: Ajani was born around 4517 AR as an albino Nacatl

events.summary: Tenoch steals Ajani's kill and savagely beats him.
events.quote: his kill was stolen by the worst of his persecutors, Tenoch

events.summary: Jazal is slain in his lair and Ajani's spark ignites as he leaves Naya.
events.quote: Jazal was slain in his lair with his black axe

events.summary: Ajani arrives on Jund, where Sarkhan Vol advises him.
events.quote: Ajani found himself on Jund

events.summary: Ajani threatens Tenoch at a cliff and falls, vanishing into the Blind Eternities.
events.quote: he vanished into the Blind Eternities

events.summary: Ajani wakes in Elspeth's care on Bant.
events.quote: Ajani woke up in the care of Elspeth Tirel on Bant

events.summary: Ajani learns Zaliki killed Jazal at Marisi's manipulation.
events.quote: Zaliki was the one responsible for his brother's death, but had been manipulated into doing so by Marisi

events.summary: Ajani absorbs the last of the Maelstrom and banishes Bolas from Alara.
events.quote: he called up an effigy of Bolas's soul and used it to banish Bolas from Alara

events.summary: Ajani declines to become Kha and leaves Naya, entrusting Zaliki.
events.quote: chose to leave Naya instead, entrusting Zaliki with the responsibilities of being the Kha

events.summary: Ajani finds Elspeth in the gladiator pits of Urborg and urges her to return.
events.quote: He finally found the errant knight in the gladiator pits of Urborg

events.summary: Ajani tracks Elspeth to Theros.
events.quote: he tracked her to the plane of Theros

events.summary: Elspeth strikes down Xenagos in Nyx.
events.quote: the pair battled the god until at last Elspeth struck him down

events.summary: Heliod murders Elspeth with her own weapon.
events.quote: Heliod appeared and used her weapon to murder Elspeth

events.summary: Ajani reveals Heliod's murder in Meletis and spreads the message that gods are creations of belief; he earns his place among Theros's leonin.
events.quote: With that, he earned his place amongst the leonin of Theros.

events.summary: Ajani rescues Oviya, Nissa and Chandra from a gas-filled cell in the Dhund.
events.quote: he forced the chamber door open, finding Oviya as well as Nissa and Chandra

events.summary: Ajani joins the Gatewatch after the Renegade victory.
events.quote: He took his oath to protect the innocent from tyrants and to help all beings find their place

events.summary: Ajani recruits Jhoira and the Weatherlight crew on Dominaria.
events.quote: recruited Jhoira and her Weatherlight crew to help in an undisclosed venture

events.summary: Ajani goes with the Gatewatch to Ravnica and is trapped by Bolas's Immortal Sun.
events.quote: Ajani traveled with the Gatewatch to Ravnica for the final confrontation with Bolas

events.summary: Ajani creates Aetherial copies of leonin allies to bolster the resistance.
events.quote: He bolstered the anti-Bolas forces by creating Aetherial copies of his leonin allies from Naya and Theros

events.summary: Ajani and others evacuate civilians into the tunnels beneath Ravnica.
events.quote: they were able to evacuate many civilians to the tunnels beneath the city

events.summary: At Ajani's request Elspeth leaves to learn how her home plane survived a Phyrexian invasion.
events.quote: At his request, Elspeth left for the plane to learn the secret of its survival

events.summary: Ajani is captured and compleated, then returned as a sleeper agent.
events.quote: he was captured and compleated

events.summary: At the Mana Rig the compleated Ajani reveals himself, killing Jaya Ballard and helping capture Karn.
events.quote: he revealed his compleation, killing Jaya Ballard

events.summary: Ajani fights Teferi over the Weatherlight's powerstone core to stop him traveling back in time, and is sent off a cliff.
events.quote: Ajani was eventually defeated and sent off a cliff

events.summary: Ajani joins the Machine Orthodoxy and presides over Karn's dismantling.
events.quote: Ajani joined the Machine Orthodoxy and presided over Karn's dismantling

events.summary: Ajani intercepts the strike force at the Seedcore and Elspeth knocks him unconscious.
events.quote: Elspeth pummeled him with the hilt of her blade, knocking him unconscious

events.summary: Ajani executes the praetor Sheoldred on Norn's command.
events.quote: Ajani executed the praetor Sheoldred

events.summary: Ajani compleats at least three of Theros's gods, including Heliod.
events.quote: He succeeded in compleating at least three of Theros's gods, including Heliod

events.summary: Kaya kills Heliod and Ajani faces off with her.
events.quote: After Kaya Cassir appeared on Theros and killed Heliod

events.summary: Teferi, Karn and Melira restore Ajani's body and purify his Phyrexian enhancements at Zhalfir.
events.quote: Teferi, Karn, and Melira restored his body and purified his Phyrexian enhancements

events.summary: Ajani finds Nahiri, who rebuffs him and destroys her own spark.
events.quote: finding only Nahiri

events.summary: Ajani finds refuge on Tarkir.
events.quote: Ajani found refuge on Tarkir

events.summary: Ajani helps Narset and Elspeth against Sarkhan's wild dragons until Ugin intervenes.
events.quote: they were saved by the intervention of Ugin

events.summary: Ajani learns Bolas escaped the Meditation Realm and that Jace's spell seemingly unmade him.
events.quote: Bolas, who had secretly survived the War of the Spark to be imprisoned in the Realm, had escaped

events.summary: Ajani rescues Kirol from Morcant's forces on Lorwyn-Shadowmoor.
events.quote: Ajani separated Kirol from the elven forces

events.summary: Ajani saves the poisoned Tamira with dawnglow.
events.quote: Ajani worked healing magic, saving Tamira with the help of dawnglow retrieved by Kirol

events.summary: Ajani protects the Dawning Archaic from Chandra.
events.quote: but Ajani protected it and fought her off

events.summary: Ajani, Chandra, Vraska and Garruk go to the Echoverse to confront Jace.
events.quote: took an Omenpath to the Echoverse

events.summary: Vraska stabs Jace to let his aspects overpower the Theorist, and Jace dies after instructing Ajani.
events.quote: He reached out to his rescuers, imparting Ajani with instructions on how to fix the disaster he caused, and died peacefully

events.summary: Emrakul appears and consumes the collapsing Echoverse.
events.quote: Emrakul appeared overhead and began to consume it
